name: pr-review-board
description: React to a pull request with an emoji and a background Claude reviews it: a local poller spawns one review agent per changeset in its own herdr workspace, which writes the review to a board drawn in a /reviewboard pane beside it, a plain-English report linked to the code it calls out and the numbered comments it proposes. It posts only the ones you pick. Approves only when you say so, never pushes.
